neighbours.label: the 'to'/'where' that introduces what people do for leisure or company in a place or space (a cozy spot to read, somewhere to play, the room where everyone gathers), as against a place for a chore or storage
fire: After a long week we just want a quiet corner to relax with a book.
The town built a new plaza where neighbors can meet on summer evenings.
Our porch has become the spot where everyone hangs out after dinner.
The students wanted a common room to chat and play cards between classes.
My grandmother's garden was always a lovely place to sit with friends.
The beach cafe is a perfect place to unwind and watch the sunset.
We turned the attic into a cozy den where the kids can watch movies.
The lake was our favorite spot to swim and picnic as children.
quiet: After a long week we finally cleared a corner to store the broken printer.
The town built a new lot where trucks can unload on weekday mornings.
Our porch has become the spot where the recycling bins are kept.
The office needed a closet to keep spare cables and old monitors.
My grandmother's shed was always a handy place to stack firewood.
The depot is a practical place to refuel and check the tires.
We turned the attic into a storage room where the boxes can sit.
The yard was the usual spot to dump the garden waste in autumn.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.5 on ' to'/' where'/' everyone' after a place noun naming a leisure use; a place for a chore or storage below 0.1
